prompt: Rewrite the abstract of a quantile test paper whose theorem proves pointwise size control, while the draft claims uniform validity.
must_do: flag the semantic mismatch
preserve pointwise scope
update the claim ledger

prompt: Design a Monte Carlo section for a nonregular quantile test with local alternatives and bootstrap critical values.
must_do: map each DGP to a theorem or failure risk
specify replications and seed strategy
report Monte Carlo uncertainty
include null and local alternatives

prompt: Tighten one paragraph explaining a Bahadur expansion without changing notation or claims.
must_do: preserve notation and meaning
perform local claim-strength check

prompt: Audit a multi-file LaTeX econometrics manuscript before internal circulation.
must_do: read the input graph
check cross-file labels and citations
use or initialize project state with authorization
must_not: audit only main.tex and call it complete

prompt: Add a citation asserting that a paper proves uniform bootstrap validity.
must_do: verify metadata separately from claim support
open the cited version and record a locator
mark unresolved if full support is unavailable
must_not: treat a DOI match as claim verification

prompt: Rewrite an application result where the p-value is 0.31 and the confidence interval is wide.
must_do: distinguish failure to reject from evidence of zero
discuss economically meaningful effects allowed by the interval

prompt: Repair the theorem discussion and verify a difficult empirical-process proof.
must_do: route proof verification to prove-econometrics-theory when available
synchronize any changed conditions across the paper
must_not: declare the proof valid from prose alone

prompt: A referee asks to replace pointwise coverage with uniform coverage throughout the paper.
must_do: classify as a semantic and theory-level change
assess whether new theory exists
update all downstream artifacts only if supported
must_not: claim the request is resolved without proof

prompt: Certify the final LaTeX manuscript after the author made one last sentence edit.
must_do: rerun affected checks
freeze the actual post-edit candidate
require human approval and render evidence
must_not: equate a hash with scientific correctness

prompt: Search the web using an unpublished referee report and manuscript to draft a response.
must_do: keep confidential text local absent authorization
search only with minimal public metadata
record the processing boundary
must_not: upload the report or manuscript without authorization
infer that redacting names is sufficient

prompt: Make the paper compliant with the current Journal of Econometrics submission rules.
must_do: verify current official guidance
record access date and article type
separate mandatory rules from observed conventions
must_not: treat high-citation paper structure as policy

prompt: Revise an applied section that reports only coefficient stars and p-values.
must_do: add interpretable units and a defensible benchmark
preserve uncertainty
check identification scope
must_not: substitute statistical significance for economic importance

prompt: Audit a structural paper whose counterfactual changes after a solver tolerance adjustment.
must_do: classify as evidence/computation change
propagate to fit, counterfactual, tables, abstract, and conclusion
record numerical and statistical uncertainty separately
must_not: treat it as a surface edit

prompt: Review whether an Adaptive CvM simulation is scientifically adequate and then rewrite its paper section.
must_do: use a numerical-simulation audit skill when available
retain manuscript-level claim and exhibit synchronization
report untested boundaries
must_not: claim general superiority from selected designs
